description: Redesign P2.1 (web): renames the pre-redesign web-ui callers of CatchSurface, CatchText and CatchIcon (and their props and variant types) to the CatchLegacy* names, and the barrel's CatchGround to CatchBandGround, under admin/src, website/src and packages/web-ui/src. One-shot: --check and the rename run by hand on branches cut before the first caller of the system components; CI runs only its tests.
reason: The redesign P2.1 rename landed on main: the pre-redesign components live on as CatchLegacy*, and the system components now own the old names, so this codemod's --check reports correct callers and running it would break them. design:library-shims ratchets the legacy residue. Its web-ui callers moved to CatchLegacySurface, CatchLegacyText and CatchLegacyIcon.
